title: Stabilizer-rank bound submission
description: A claimed bound on chi(|M>^{ot m}) for one magic-state orbit. Upper bounds carry an explicit decomposition whose terms are given by their stabilizer parametrisation, so a term that is not a stabilizer state cannot be expressed. Lower bounds carry a certificate script that must run and assert.

orbit.description: S Strange, N Norrell, H3 qutrit Hadamard eigenstate, T3 qutrit T-type (face centre), qubit_H qubit H-type (edge centre), qubit_T qubit Bravyi-Kitaev T-type

m.description: number of copies; capped by the verification budget

witness.description: required for an upper bound to earn the verified tier

W.description: k rows of length m spanning the flat; must be injective

Q.description: quadratic phase form, read upper-triangular and mod p; the phase is w_p^Q(y) for odd p and (-1)^Q(y) for qubits

l.description: linear phase, length k; the phase is w_p^(l.y) for odd p and i^(l.y) for qubits, with l read mod 4 so that every qubit stabilizer state is expressible

coeffs.description: exact sympy expressions, e.g. '3/4 + sqrt(3)*I/4'; no floats

lean.description: required for the lean tier; the module must build and the named theorem must be the bound as stated

theorem.description: name of the theorem inside that module

certificate.description: required for a lower bound to earn the reproduced tier

script.description: path relative to the repository root

reference.description: where the bound comes from, e.g. 'arXiv:2605.28586' or 'stabrank PR #16'

method.description: how it was obtained, in one line

date.description: when the bound first appeared: the arXiv v1 date for a literature value, otherwise the date of the work

github.description: GitHub handles, without the @; binds the entry to its authors

compute.description: what the search that produced this bound consumed, aggregated by the site into the discovery ledger. Report what was spent finding the bound, across every run including the failed ones, not what the verifier spends checking it

cpu_hours.description: CPU core-hours over every run that led to the bound

wall_clock_hours.description: elapsed time from the first run to the bound

runs.description: independent search runs, successful or not

hardware.description: machine the search ran on, e.g. 'Apple M3 Max, 14 cores' or 'AWS p5.48xlarge'

llm.description: LLM usage during the search, one entry per model

model.description: model identifier as the provider names it, e.g. 'claude-fable-5-1'

role.description: what the model did: 'drove the search', 'wrote the certificate', 'proposed the ansatz'

cost_usd.description: total spend in US dollars, if known
